```python
# Find cyclists ranked between Denis Menchov and Stéphane Goubert
menchov_rank = df.loc[df['Cyclist'].str.contains('Menchov'), 'Rank'].values[0]
goubert_rank = df.loc[df['Cyclist'].str.contains('Goubert'), 'Rank'].values[0]

between = df[(df['Rank'] > menchov_rank) & (df['Rank'] < goubert_rank)]

answer = between['Cyclist'].tolist()
print(answer)
```

**Answer:** Samuel Sánchez (ESP) of Euskaltel-Euskadi, who was ranked 7th — between Denis Menchov (6th) and Stéphane Goubert (8th).
